A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Meta-Expert research and contain 16 readable pages, including complete appendices. Text comparison and visual inspection support comparison of all scientific content.

before.justification: v1.pdf reports original benchmark experiments, component ablations, pseudo-label analyses, and computational measurements, including FreeMatch experiments in Appendix C.

after.justification: v2.pdf retains these original experiments and analyses in the main text and Appendix C.

M1.justification: Sections 3.2–3.3 retain the same three experts, DEA module, weighted-logit aggregator, MFF module, losses, warm-up, and prediction procedure. Algorithm 1 is relocated without changing its steps.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate CIFAR-10-LT, SVHN-LT, and STL-10-LT under the same distribution scenarios. Appendix C retains the same dataset and task coverage.

E2.justification: Tables 4–5 and 8–9 retain the same supervised and base SSL controls and SAW, Adsh, DePL, ACR, BaCon, CPE, and SimPro comparators. The expert comparisons are also unchanged.

E3.justification: Sections 4.1–4.2 and Appendix C preserve the dataset sizes, imbalance ratios, splits, metrics, model architecture, optimization settings, and FixMatch/FreeMatch evaluation procedures.

E4.justification: The feature-depth analysis, pseudo-label analyses, DEA/MFF ablations, addition-versus-concatenation comparison, expert-assignment visualization, and computational overhead analysis are all retained without revision.

E5.justification: Both versions specify three random seeds and reporting means and standard deviations in Section 4.2. The uncertainty reporting in Tables 4–5 and 8–9 is unchanged.

E6.justification: Tables 1–9, Figures 1 and 3, and the accompanying numerical and qualitative findings match. For example, the first Meta-Expert result remains 74.39±0.46 in Table 4 and 75.68±0.28 in Appendix Table 8.

T1.justification: Section 3.4 retains the same risk definitions, assumptions, and generalization bound. Appendix D preserves Theorem 1, both lemmas, and all proof derivations unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions, and conclusion retain the same claims about expert assignment, generalization error, feature-depth bias, and benchmark performance.

C2.justification: The explanations of expert specialization, feature bias, module complementarity, MFF's inverse-distribution exception, and computational tradeoffs are unchanged. No substantive qualification or limitation is added.

D1.justification: The implementation settings, hardware, software version, computational measurements, pseudocode, and code access information are unchanged. The code link merely reflows across columns.

R1.justification: The citations, reference list, Section 2, and Appendix B remain unchanged, including the positioning relative to CPE, RIDE, SADE, and BalPoE.

P1.justification: v2.pdf corrects 'School of School of Computer Science and Engineering' to 'School of Computer Science and Engineering' and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. Scientific prose and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Minor page and column reflow moves Algorithm 1 from the right to the left column of page 6 and Equation 2 from page 5 to page 4. Figures, tables, captions, and appendix layouts remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: The affiliation typo correction provides a small cosmetic benefit, accompanied by minor layout reflow. The scientific argument, empirical evidence, reproducibility information, and complete appendices are unchanged, establishing no meaningful overall quality difference.
